text: There is a very specific palm tree that was worked on, that uses the same approach as the grass
resolution: Palm trees the grass way, into the compiled game (commits 0025b50bd + 3194b5608). The proven cart/tree_probe palm (PalmTrunk + ~frond~ crown) is now a paintable foliage system: a new 'Palm Grove' tile (in all three synced tile tables) sparsely grows palms over painted cells via render3d/palmPopulation (a trunk + a Frond crown ported from tree_probe's tree()/crown()), riding the SAME eachPaintedCell walk grass/bush use (extracted, grass byte-identical: 33968/231700). Bake: INSTANCE_SHAPE_FROND + pushPalms (cylinder trunk + frond cards). Loader: buildFrond() (compiled twin of Frond.ts) + SHAPE_FROND batch routed to the existing ~frond~ pipeline; streaming whiten-skip spares ~frond~. Verified end-to-end via diagnostic shot (user confirmed: trunks + green frond crowns render). v1 trunk is a plain cylinder; PalmTrunk-geometry/frond-style-variety/trunk-collision/settings-tunables are follow-ups. Paint Palm Grove + recompile (loader rebuilds on next rjit game play) to see them.
